No source/test/contract edits, fullsuite/build/Spectre/remote runs performed. Compile-only original fixture materializations and three bounded malformed raw requests against the matching existing kernel are saved in lane5-probe.json. Pure Python/Fraction RN probes include original operands and derivations.

Current public runtime validates solution count, finite voltages, requested time/state/evidence shapes. Local zip/all alone was not flagged as vacuous when these public guards establish completeness. Raw subprocess-only tests do not inherit those guards.

Every assigned method body was read with its module fixtures; actual assertions/expected expressions are recorded per method. Internal representation tests are labeled by their narrow contract; they are not waveform qualification. Shared-checker positive fixtures are labeled consistency evidence and their unresolved independent calibration is recorded.

Prior691failure audit entries were inspected for revalidation hints only, not used as wholemethod certification or verdict dispatch. Parent coordinator supplied matched-kernel independent-driver raw evidence; that external evidence is explicitly identified.

Some legacy negative tests may currently encounter earlier implementation rejection; a valid static oracle does not prove the named native mechanism executed. No broad negative or passing test was credited with wholetrajectory guarantees.

withdrawn_findings.reason: 虽然 due=$abstime+0.1 的程序 RN 值不同于旧 Fraction(1,3)+Fraction(.1)，RN 值恰是旧精确和的向上相邻 binary64；前一 binary64 严格小于旧精确和。因此不存在位于 [旧 due, 新 due) 的 binary64 查询点，两个计数相位 oracle 在全部可表示查询点上一致。时间差为1/108086391056891904，小于1e-17。atan(3t)/3 的导数至多1，expm1 在[0,.75]的导数小于e，故 seen 样本差小于3e-17，远低于1e-8断言。两个正例不能仅因旧表达式未显式 RN 就判错。exact_callback 的初始化记录数量问题另见L5-F01，混合历史拒绝的精确锚点前提仍保留为证据缺口。
